title: AgentTrail audit trail record
description: One append-only JSONL audit record per completed audited decision. Structured audit artefact designed to support Article 12 traceability. Shared applicant fields reuse the exact enums of data/golden_cases.schema.json; the record additionally carries operational fields (decision outcome, confidence, templated rationale, model_id, prompt_version, timestamp) and is therefore NOT the golden-case schema. Every string is constrained by an enum, a bounded identifier pattern, or the canonical timestamp format; no free-text or nested metadata fields are permitted.

case_ref.description: Bounded opaque case reference; same convention as the golden dataset case_id. Never a real reference number, never prose.

age_band.description: Enumerated applicant band; identical enum to golden input.age_band.

income_band.description: Enumerated applicant band; identical enum to golden input.income_band.

evidence_status.description: Enumerated evidence state; identical enum to golden input.evidence_status.

decision.description: Final routing after the confidence threshold; identical enum to golden expected.routing.

confidence.description: Model-reported confidence, finite, in [0.0, 1.0]. Uncalibrated in v1; not a statistical probability.

rationale.description: Rendering of an allow-listed local template filled only with the enumerated case fields above. Never model free text; the application additionally enforces exact cross-field agreement with decision, evidence_status and income_band.

model_id.description: Effective Bedrock model or inference-profile ID actually sent to converse(). Bounded identifier; no whitespace.

prompt_version.description: Semantic version of the prompt contract (system instruction, tool schema, templates); same version convention as golden dataset_version.

timestamp.description: Generated internally at record build time. Canonical RFC 3339 UTC, second precision, trailing Z. Never caller-supplied in production.
